title: Aarav & Meera — A new chapter
message: Some stories are written in the stars. Ours will be celebrated with you. Join us for an evening of music, laughter and a lifetime of beginnings.
story: We met over a forgotten umbrella and a cup of chai. One conversation became a thousand, and somewhere between the laughter and the long walks, we found home. Now, our favourite chapter begins.
dressCode: Festive Indian wear in ivory, blush or antique gold
arrivalNotes: Please arrive 30 minutes before the ceremony. Contact the host for parking and accessibility assistance.
giftsNote: Your presence and blessings are our greatest gifts.
